description: Use before create_proof to see what a proof will cost right now. Proof $1 + network fee, no API key. Current prices for every proof type. Each is a flat USD service fee plus the Bitcoin network fee on top: proof $1, publication $1, deed (Ownership Token) $1, artwork (Certificate of Provenance) $1. Returns the service fee in USD and sats, the address it is paid to, current network fee rates (sat/vB, never below 5) and an estimated network fee. Read-only; nothing is reserved.
name: get_quote
title: Get prices
